quickAnswer.title: Airfare & Transfers: The 60-Second Answer
paragraphs: If you're short on time here's what to know before you book your flights and arrival arrangements.
Our Recommendation: Book your flights early, arrive the day before your cruise, and consider working with a luxury travel advisor to coordinate flights, hotels, and transfers.
highlights: Airfare usually isn't included in the cruise fare
Airport transfers are often included on eligible itineraries
Arrive at least one day before embarkation
Scenic staff assist with luggage at embarkation
Book flights early for the best fares

airfareInclusions.title: Does Scenic Include Airfare?
airfareInclusions.subtitle: In most cases, airfare is not automatically included in the standard Scenic River Cruise fare.
inclusions: Customized vacation packages that include flights
Fly Free promotions on select itineraries
Flexible routing options with major airlines
Convenient pre- and post-cruise flight connections
airfareInclusions.expertNote: In most cases, airfare is not automatically included in the standard Scenic River Cruise fare. Because offers change throughout the year, it's worth comparing current promotions before booking.

airportTransfers.title: Are Airport Transfers Included?
paragraphs: One of Scenic's luxury benefits is that airport transfers are often included on eligible itineraries. Transfers are designed to ensure seamless transit from arrival to boarding.
Eligibility depends on your booking conditions, itinerary, and how your flights were arranged. Always review your confirmation documents for exact details.
highlights: Between the airport and your ship
Between the airport and your hotel (if arranged through Scenic)
At the beginning and end of your cruise
airportTransfers.badgeDescription: Seamless luxury airport transfers included on eligible itineraries.

bookingFlights.title: Should You Book Flights Through Scenic?
bookingFlights.subtitle: There are advantages to both options here's how they compare.

items.title: Booking Through Scenic
items.description: Booking your flights through Scenic can simplify the entire trip, especially for guests who prefer a single point of contact for their travel arrangements.
features: Coordinated flight schedules matched to embarkation
Easier transfer arrangements directly from airport to ship
One point of contact for air and cruise arrangements
Simplified travel planning with integrated itineraries
items.highlight: Best for travelers seeking effortless, single-source coordination

items.title: Booking Flights Independently
items.description: Some guests prefer to book their own flights for more control over airline choice and loyalty benefits. If booking independently, allow plenty of time between your flight and embarkation.
features: Greater airline and alliance choice
Frequent flyer and loyalty program benefits
Flexible departure times and custom routing
Opportunity to use credit card reward points or miles
items.highlight: Best for travelers with airline loyalty status or custom schedules

cards.title: Should You Stay in a Hotel Before Your Cruise?
items: Yes especially recommended for long-haul international flights
Recover comfortably from jet lag before embarkation begins
Significantly reduce travel stress and missed connection risks
Extra time to explore your European embarkation city at leisure
Many travelers also extend their vacation with post-cruise hotel stays

cards.title: Luggage Handling & Valuables
items: Scenic staff assist with luggage during embarkation and disembarkation
Enjoy less heavy lifting and hassle-free transit to your stateroom
Smooth, seamless arrival and departure experience at every port
Keep valuables, medications, passports, and travel documents in your carry-on
Label all luggage pieces clearly with Scenic baggage tags

whenToArrive.title: When Should You Arrive?
subtitles: Our recommendation: Arrive at least one day before embarkation to protect against international flight disruptions.
features: Weather delays and severe weather disruptions
Airline schedule changes and flight cancellations
Missed tight flight connections at hub airports
Lengthy customs and European immigration queues
Delayed or misplaced checked luggage
whenToArrive.summary: Arriving early reduces stress and gives you time to explore your embarkation city. To minimize the impact of delays, book nonstop flights when possible, purchase comprehensive travel insurance, and keep Scenic's emergency contact information accessible.

embarkationVsDeparture.title: Embarkation Day vs. Departure Day

rows: Arrive at the ship or designated meeting point
Luggage is collected and delivered to your suite

Guests continue to the airport or post-cruise accommodations

embarkationCities.subtitle: Depending on your itinerary, Scenic cruises often begin or end in these cities destinations worth exploring in their own right.

cards.description: Historic canal rings, world-class art museums, and picturesque merchant houses make Amsterdam a vibrant gateway for Rhine sailings.
features: Canal-lined streets and historic waterways
World-class museums including the Rijksmuseum

cards.title: Basel
cards.description: Located where Switzerland, France, and Germany meet, Basel offers ancient history, modern architecture, and scenic Rhine vistas.
features: Gateway to the majestic Swiss Alps
Vibrant international art and museum scene

cards.title: Budapest
cards.description: The Queen of the Danube features grand thermal baths, the illuminated Parliament Building, and castle district panoramas.
features: Historic mineral-rich thermal bathhouses
Stunning panoramic Danube river views

cards.title: Vienna
cards.description: The capital of classical music, Vienna enchants with grand imperial palaces, historic coffeehouses, and baroque architecture.
features: Imperial Habsburg palaces and gardens
Rich classical musical heritage and opera

cards.title: Paris
cards.description: The City of Light serves as the romantic embarkation point for Seine River cruises through Normandy to the Atlantic coast.
features: World-famous iconic monuments and landmarks
World-renowned gastronomy and haute cuisine

cards.title: Porto
cards.description: Portugal's northern gem welcomes Douro cruisers with colorful tiered houses, medieval streets, and historic wine cellars.

inlineCta2.description: Most included excursions use luxury motor coaches, comfortable minibuses, walking tours, and Scenic's private transportation where applicable coordinated to match your daily itinerary.

commonMistakes.title: Common Travel Mistakes
commonMistakes.subtitle: Many first-time Scenic guests make these mistakes. Working with a luxury travel advisor can help you avoid them.

items.title: Flying in on Embarkation Day
items.description: Tight same-day arrivals leave zero margin for flight delays, tarmac holds, or missed international connections.

items.title: Booking Flights with Multiple Tight Connections
items.description: Selecting the cheapest ticket with short layovers significantly increases the risk of missed connections and lost luggage.

items.title: Forgetting Comprehensive Travel Insurance
items.description: Traveling abroad without coverage leaves you vulnerable to unforeseen medical issues, cancellation costs, and delay expenses.

items.title: Assuming Transfers Are Automatically Included
items.description: Failing to check specific fare inclusions and eligibility rules may lead to unexpected out-of-pocket taxi or rail costs.

items.title: Packing Passports in Checked Luggage
items.description: Always keep passports, boarding documents, and vital medications in your carry-on bag at all times during travel.

items.title: Booking Very Early Morning Return Flights
items.description: Scheduling flights before 11:00 AM on disembarkation day causes unnecessary morning stress and risk of missed flights.

faqs.question: Is airfare included with Scenic River Cruises?
faqs.answer: Usually no. Airfare is generally separate unless included in a special promotion or customized vacation package.

faqs.question: Are airport transfers included?
faqs.answer: Many Scenic itineraries include airport transfers under certain booking conditions. Check your confirmation documents for eligibility.

faqs.question: Should I arrive the day before my cruise?
faqs.answer: Yes. Arriving one day before embarkation helps avoid stress caused by flight delays or missed connections.

faqs.question: Can Scenic book my flights?
faqs.answer: Scenic may assist with air arrangements as part of selected packages or promotions. Your travel advisor can also help coordinate flights.

faqs.question: What happens if my flight is delayed?
faqs.answer: Contact Scenic or your travel advisor immediately. Travel insurance and arriving early are the best ways to minimize disruption.

faqs.question: Are luggage transfers included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic staff typically assist with luggage during embarkation and disembarkation.

faqs.question: Should I stay in a hotel before my cruise?
faqs.answer: Most experienced travelers recommend staying at least one night before embarkation, particularly after international flights.

faqs.question: When should I book my flights?
faqs.answer: Booking several months in advance often provides the best combination of pricing and flight availability.

faqs.question: Can I book my own airfare?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many guests choose to book independently using airline loyalty programs or preferred carriers.

faqs.question: Should I purchase travel insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes. Travel insurance is strongly recommended to protect against unexpected delays, cancellations, medical emergencies, and lost luggage.

faqs.question: How early should I book my return flight?
faqs.answer: Avoid scheduling very early departures. Allow sufficient time after disembarkation for transfers, airport security, and check-in.

faqs.question: Should I use a travel advisor for flights and transfers?
faqs.answer: Yes. A luxury travel advisor can coordinate flights, hotels, airport transfers, and your Scenic cruise into one seamless itinerary.

finalVerdict.title: Plan Your Arrival for a Smooth Start
finalVerdict.subtitle: Final Verdict
paragraphs: Planning your airfare and arrival carefully is one of the easiest ways to ensure your Scenic River Cruise begins smoothly. While airfare is generally booked separately, Scenic often includes airport transfers on eligible bookings and provides excellent support throughout the embarkation process.

For the most relaxed experience, arrive at least one day before your cruise and confirm your transfer arrangements in advance. At Trips & Ships Luxury Travel, we'll work with you as a trusted advisor who can coordinate every detail of your journey, from flights and transfers to hotels and embarkation.
